press_references.value: Toku Powers Glovo's Sales Operations Across Four European Markets

partnership_announcements.description: Toku and Glovo have begun the first phase of a broad enterprise partnership, deploying Toku's CX platform to power Glovo's sales operations in Spain, Italy, Romania and Portugal, with plans to extend to 18 additional markets.

press_references.value: Toku Enters Middle East Market with its First Regional Deployments

press_references.value: Toku Goes Live in Latin America with PedidosYa, Marking Strategic Global Expansion

partnership_announcements.description: Toku announced a strategic partnership with PedidosYa to deploy its enterprise Contact Centre solution across PedidosYa’s operations in Colombia, Peru, Paraguay, and Uruguay, supporting 1,400+ agents and enabling CX at scale across the region.

The system routes conversations and processes customer requests.

product.name: Toku Contact Centre
product.description: A cloud-based omnichannel contact centre platform for managing customer interactions across voice, messaging, and digital channels, with AI capabilities for agent assistance and customer experience management.

product.name: Toku AI for Productivity
product.description: AI productivity solutions designed to improve employee efficiency and customer interactions, with support for APAC languages and accents.

product.name: Toku Conversational AI
product.description: An AI-powered conversational platform for customer service, marketing, and commerce across messaging and social channels.

product.name: Toku Carrier Services
product.description: Enterprise voice and SMS connectivity services providing APAC numbering, PSTN replacement, messaging aggregation, and carrier infrastructure for providers, resellers, and enterprises.

product.name: Toku for Microsoft Teams
product.description: A telephony integration for Microsoft Teams that enables business calling on Teams across devices and locations.

product.name: Toku for Zoom Phone
product.description: A business telephony service that provides Zoom Phone calling with Toku’s enterprise voice connectivity.
